# llms.txt

Weather Forecast Pro (weather-forecast-jilimb0.netlify.app) — Real-time Weather & Hourly Outlook

Weather Forecast Pro (weather-forecast-jilimb0.netlify.app) is a production-ready weather forecast application with accurate hourly predictions, 5-day outlook, atmospheric metrics, and offline PWA support powered by a Netlify Function API backend.

## Core Capabilities

- **Normalized Weather API**: Stable public API at `GET /api/weather?lat={number}&lon={number}`.
- **Hourly Strip**: Next 24 hours in 3-hour slots.
- **5-Day Outlook**: Aggregated daily weather conditions, temperature range, and wind trends.
- **Offline PWA**: Service Worker caching of assets and latest forecasts.

## Links

- [Live Deployment](https://weather-forecast-jilimb0.netlify.app)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/jilimb0/weather-forecast)
